about.text: Nabulsi is a brined cheese from Nablus in the West Bank, made mainly from sheep's milk (goat's or cow's also, or a sheep-cow blend called mashmouleh). The pressed curd is boiled and stored in brine flavoured with mastic and mahleb. It is soaked to remove salt before it is used in knafeh.
